## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `float` | [getU](#ObjTextureCoordinate-method-getU)() | Returns the horizontal coordinate, `0F` at the left of the texture. |
| `float` | [getV](#ObjTextureCoordinate-method-getV)() | Returns the vertical coordinate; [`ObjModel`](/reference/drawing/objmodel/) flips the `vt` value of the file so that `0F` is the top of the texture. |
| `float` | [getW](#ObjTextureCoordinate-method-getW)() | Returns the depth coordinate of a 3D texture, read from the file and unused when drawing. |

## Method details

<a id="ObjTextureCoordinate-method-getU"></a>

### getU

`float getU()` 

Returns the horizontal coordinate, `0F` at the left of the texture.

<a id="ObjTextureCoordinate-method-getV"></a>

### getV

`float getV()` 

Returns the vertical coordinate; [`ObjModel`](/reference/drawing/objmodel/) flips the `vt` value of the file so that `0F` is the top of the texture.

<a id="ObjTextureCoordinate-method-getW"></a>

### getW

`float getW()` 

Returns the depth coordinate of a 3D texture, read from the file and unused when drawing.
